name: element-picker
description: DaVinchi — Element Picker for VS Code & Cursor. Click a DOM element, capture screenshot + HTML/CSS context, feed any terminal AI agent.

commands.title: DaVinchi: Attach Last Pick to Terminal
DaVinchi: Copy Last Paths to Clipboard
DaVinchi: Open Rich UI in Editor
DaVinchi: Copy Local Chrome CDP Command

elementPicker.language.description: UI language for DaVinchi Element Picker (panel, status bar, notifications). Saved in user settings by default when changed from the panel or command palette.

elementPicker.outputDir.description: Folder (relative to workspace root) where picks are saved.

elementPicker.defaultUrl.description: Optional last-used / preferred URL. Leave empty — you always paste any local or external link yourself.

elementPicker.browserChannel.description: Preferred browser for Playwright: system Chrome, Edge, or bundled Chromium.

elementPicker.browserPath.description: Optional full path to chrome.exe / msedge.exe when browserMode=launch. Application-scoped so a workspace cannot inject an executable path.

enumDescriptions: Launch system Chrome/Edge on this PC if found; else try CDP. Works for local and Remote SSH (extension runs as UI on your machine).
Always spawn Chrome/Edge on this machine.
Only connect to an existing Chrome at cdpEndpoint (advanced).
elementPicker.browserMode.description: How to attach the browser. Default auto works for both local folders and Remote SSH.

elementPicker.cdpEndpoint.description: Chrome DevTools endpoint. Start local Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222. On Remote SSH reverse-forward this port to your PC.

elementPicker.maxHtmlBytes.description: Max outerHTML size (bytes) written to context.md.

elementPicker.terminalPrompt.description: Text prefix inserted into the terminal before file paths. Leave empty to use the localized default for the selected language.

elementPicker.autoAttach.description: After a successful pick: write files, paste paths into terminal, and copy paths to clipboard.

elementPicker.cloneZip.description: Clone mode: build a zip archive of the full pack (<timestamp>/clone.zip and latest/clone.zip).

elementPicker.cloneLatest.description: Clone mode: mirror every capture into the latest/ folder (stable paths for agents).

elementPicker.clonePreviewHtml.description: Clone mode: write self-contained clone/preview.html (HTML + CSS + screenshots + assets inlined).

elementPicker.cloneAssets.description: Clone mode: download images, fonts and icons into clone/assets/.

elementPicker.clonePageScreenshot.description: Clone mode: capture the full-page screenshot clone/page.png.

elementPicker.cloneParentScreenshot.description: Clone mode: capture the parent-area screenshot clone/parent.png.

elementPicker.cloneComputedJson.description: Clone mode: write style dumps clone/computed.json and clone/fonts.json.

elementPicker.cloneInlineSvgs.description: Clone mode: write inline-XX.svg files found in the subtree.

elementPicker.cloneFullSite.description: Clone mode: capture the WHOLE page (full HTML, styles, assets) on any click — full site reference instead of a single element.

elementPicker.cloneOneShot.description: Clone mode: one-shot — the mode deactivates automatically after a successful capture.

scripts.package:out: npm run package && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const n=p.name+'-'+p.version+'.vsix';fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(n,'dist/'+n);console.log('dist/'+n)"
